text: setup: refuse to run inside the gittoc dev checkout (deletes .git)

Fixed in scripts/setup: GIT_ROOTDIR is resolved (and validated) before the rm loop; setup now exits 1 when the gittoc dir is/contains the git top-level or lies outside it. New TestSetupScript class (3 tests) covers vendored install, dev-checkout refusal (from root and subdir), and non-git refusal. scripts/dev/check: 160 tests OK.
